messages:
lena (ML Eng): Hey folks - i'm moving from SF -> Berlin, ETA 2025-07-01. Quick Qs: 1) do i keep WFH stipend and is it paid in EUR? 2) when does payroll change and what forms are needed? 3) any company nexus / PE concerns since i sometimes run partner workshops in EU?

jamie (People Ops): congrats! tl;dr: 1) yes, stipend continues but switches to EMEA band and paid in local currency where supported. 2) payroll moves to local provider; we need location-change + bank details by 2025-06-01 for a 2025-07-01 start. 3) maybe - legal will assess based on partner workshop frequency and signing authority. please submit the Location Change form: https://hr.redwood.example/loc-change

lena (ML Eng): thanks. EMEA band for Germany what is it? and do you prorate for the month i move?

jamie (People Ops): Germany band = 85/mo for WFH baseline. yes, we prorate by days in the month. example: prorated = round(band * days_in_country / days_in_month,2). we pay stipend in EUR if payroll supports it; otherwise we issue USD equivalent at company's FX rate on payroll date.

kevin (Finance): payroll note: final US pay run will cover earnings through 2025-06-30 if your local payroll starts 2025-07-01. required docs: W-8/other tax form replacement, local tax forms, bank details, passport. deadline to hit the payroll migration is 2025-06-01. if docs arrive late we may need a split-pay or extend US payroll for one extra cycle.

marta (Benefits): Berlin health: Redwood offers local health contribution setup for DE employees; enrollment kicks once payroll is active and can take 2-4 weeks. if you need interim coverage, consider short-term travel/expat insurance. also check pension/social security registration will begin with payroll.

legal (Legal): on nexus: one engineering headcount in DE generally doesn't create company-level permanent establishment by itself, but regular customer-facing workshops, contract negotiation, or local office space increases risk. please note the volume/frequency of partner workshops on the form; do not sign contracts locally unless pre-authorized. we'll run a nexus screen after form submission.

lena (ML Eng): i run ~1 workshop/month and occasionally host local meetups. i'll flag that in the form and won't sign anything.

payroll-bot: Location Change form received: LCF-7012 for lena (submitted 2025-05-04). Status: People Ops review pending.

jamie (People Ops): action items: lena upload passport + proof of german address when available; kevin to prepare payroll checklist; marta to queue benefits enrollment; legal to perform nexus check. i'll book 20-min sync next week. anyone else?

kevin (Finance): quick FYI on equipment shipping: if you want the company laptop shipped, fill the equipment shipping request. we cover customs but need purchase invoice for VAT reclaim where applicable.

lena (ML Eng): thanks everyone, filing the form now and will upload docs this afternoon. appreciate it! :slightly_smiling_face:
